Permits

The county issues permits for building, electrical, plumbing and mechanical work. Find the permit you need below, read its requirements, and apply online or at the permit desk. Fees depend on the project's value and the review it needs. Most residential permits are reviewed within ten business days. Commercial permits can take longer.
